<thought>Based on the most intense peak at m/z 224.12, the neutral molecular mass is approximately 224.12 Da. A plausible formula that matches this mass is C₁₂H₁₆O₄ (monoisotopic mass 224.1049 Da), which is within typical experimental error for a single‑charge ESI spectrum.</thought>
<final_answer>C12H16O4</final_answer>
